about: Budgets held by cad_b6/check_budgets.py. 'figure' is the recorded present figure; a run fails when it grows past figure x (1 + margin). Lower a figure only with check_budgets.py --write, in a commit of its own.

skeleton_abs_g.what: g of ABS at 4 walls / 20 % infill over every ABS part (frame_v0.mass_estimate); hard limit 90 % of hardware.ABS_STOCK_G

organic_cm3.what: cm3 of the organic layer (voxels with d < 0 in out/organic/field.npz); hard limit: solid PETG (organic_frame.LAYER_RHO) at most 90 % of petg_stock_g, the 4 kg ordered on 16 Nov 2026 (docs/printer-and-materials.md, 'Stock and order of printing')

suite.what: the fast test_checks.py (out/test_checks/fast.json): counts of expensive operations gate, the wall time only warns

strength.what: the full run of organic_strength.py (out/organic/strength.json): its load cases over every piece gate (more is a longer run, fewer is a push point or a probe lost), the pieces' wall time only warns; the size of what it solves follows the organic layer's volume, budgeted above
strength.recorded_from: load cases: full run of 2026-11-19 21:36:18 (revision 19); wall time: full run of 2026-11-19 04:59:25 (the later run's 1950.6 s is not recorded, so that it keeps warning)
